title: Seedwise width-three CNF
statement: Let $V$ be a nonadaptive tester with Boolean answers and $r$ query positions, fix a seed, and let $m$ be the number of clauses in its seed acceptance CNF. The seedwise width-three CNF is the width-three Tseitin construction on that CNF, with $r+(r-3)m$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a PCPP system with Boolean alphabet, input length $n$, proof length $\text{proofLength}$, and $r$ query positions
